note: 学习路线（英文模式用 title_en / sub_en / goal_en / label_en，资源换成 res_en，全部是英文资源）：每一站一句白话目标、本站对应的页面和深度（站内页面目前不能直接跳到某一层，链接打开页面，标签写明该去哪一层），再挂 2–4 个资源库里的条目（res 是 resources.json 的 id）。

nodes.title: 它只是在接龙
nodes.goal: 大模型每一步只做一件事：看着前面的所有词元，给词表里每个词元打一个分，再从中抽一个出来。
nodes.goal_en: At every step an LLM does just one thing: look at all the tokens so far, give every token in the vocabulary a score, and draw one.

site.label: 推理 · D1 黑箱
推理 · D2 结构

nodes.title: 文字先变成词元
nodes.goal: 模型看到的不是字，而是一串编号：一个词可能被切成几块，中文常常一两个字一块，连“对话”本身也被编成特殊词元。
nodes.goal_en: The model doesn't see characters, it sees a string of IDs: a word may be cut into several pieces, Chinese often goes one or two characters per piece, and even the chat structure is encoded as special tokens.

site.label: 推理 · 聊天里的点选输入法（候选就是真实分词）
site.label_en: Inference · The chat's tap-to-type input (the candidates are real tokens)

site.label: 智能体 · D3 上下文

nodes.title: 概率与抽签
nodes.goal: 模型给出的是概率，说出哪个词是掷骰子的结果：温度调高低，top-k 和 top-p 决定在哪些候选里抽。
nodes.title_en: Probabilities and a roll of the dice
nodes.goal_en: The model outputs probabilities; which word it says comes down to a roll of the dice. Temperature sharpens or flattens the odds, and top-k and top-p decide which candidates are in the draw.

site.label: 推理 · D2 结构 · 采样

nodes.title: 嵌入与残差流
nodes.goal: 每个词元先变成一条 1024 维的向量；28 层里每一层都只往这条向量上“加一点东西”，而不是替换它。
nodes.goal_en: Each token first becomes a 1,024-dimensional vector; each of the 28 layers only "adds a little" to that vector instead of replacing it.

site.label: 推理 · D2 结构（嵌入）
推理 · D3 层塔（残差流光柱）

nodes.title: 注意力：Q、K、V
nodes.goal: 每个词元用自己的 Q 去和前面每个词元的 K 打分，softmax 变成权重，再按权重把它们的 V 加起来。
nodes.goal_en: Each token scores its Q against the K of every earlier token, softmax turns the scores into weights, and their Vs are added up with those weights.

site.label: 推理 · D5 算子（注意力，16 个头可切换）
多模态 · 注意力热力图

nodes.title: 前馈网络：带阀门的神经元
nodes.goal: 注意力之后是 SwiGLU 前馈网络：3072 个神经元里只有一部分被明显点亮，模型记住的很多“知识”就存在这里。
nodes.goal_en: After attention comes the SwiGLU feed-forward network: only some of its 3,072 neurons clearly light up, and much of the "knowledge" the model remembers lives here.

site.label: 推理 · D5 算子（神经元阵列）

nodes.title: 位置、归一化与分组注意力
nodes.goal: RoPE 让模型分得清先后，RMSNorm 把数值稳在同一尺度，GQA 让几个查询头共用一组 K、V，省下一半 KV 缓存。
nodes.goal_en: RoPE lets the model tell what came first, RMSNorm keeps the numbers on one scale, and GQA lets several query heads share one set of K and V, halving the KV cache.

site.label: 推理 · D4 一层之内
推理 · D5 算子（Q·K·V）

nodes.title: 一次乘加，一个比特
nodes.goal: 所有计算最后都落到 y = Σ x·w：一个输出是上千项乘积的和；每个权重存成 16 位的 bf16。
nodes.goal_en: Every computation ends up as y = Σ x·w: one output is the sum of over a thousand products, and every weight is stored as a 16-bit bf16.

site.label: 推理 · D6 一次乘加
推理 · D7 比特
多模态 · D5 一次乘加

stages.title: 它是怎么学会的
stages.sub: 预训练、优化、微调与对齐

nodes.title: 损失与梯度下降
nodes.goal: 训练 = 算出答错了多少（交叉熵），再用反向传播求出每个权重的梯度，沿着让损失变小的方向挪一点。
nodes.goal_en: Training = measure how wrong the answer was (cross-entropy), use backpropagation to get every weight's gradient, then nudge each weight a little in the direction that lowers the loss.

site.label: 训练 · D1 训练全程（损失曲线、损失地形）
site.label_en: Training · D1 Whole run (loss curve, loss landscape)

site.label: 训练 · D4 一个位置的交叉熵
site.label_en: Training · D4 Cross-entropy at one position

nodes.title: 预训练：从零训练一个小模型
nodes.goal: 用几百万字的唐宋诗从零训练一个和 Qwen3 同构的小模型，看损失一路下降、写出来的诗越来越像样。
nodes.title_en: Pretraining: a small model from scratch
nodes.goal_en: Train a small model with Qwen3's architecture from scratch on a few million characters of Tang and Song poetry; watch the loss fall and the poems get better.

site.label: 训练 · 唐宋诗小模型（D1 预训练全程）
site.label_en: Training · Tang & Song poetry model (D1 whole pretraining run)

nodes.title: 优化器：AdamW
nodes.goal: 看懂一个权重的一次更新：梯度的一阶矩、二阶矩、偏差校正、权重衰减，以及学习率的预热和退火。
nodes.goal_en: Understand one update of one weight: the gradient's first and second moments, bias correction, weight decay, and the learning-rate warm-up and decay.

site.label: 训练 · D3 更新
训练 · D4 细到一个数（写回的比特）
site.label_en: Training · D4 Down to one number (bits written back)

nodes.title: 微调与对齐：SFT、RLHF、DPO
nodes.goal: 预训练学会“说话”，SFT 教它按对话格式回答，偏好对齐再教它在两个回答之间挑更好的那个。
nodes.title_en: Fine-tuning and alignment: SFT, RLHF, DPO
nodes.goal_en: Pretraining teaches it to talk, SFT teaches it to answer in chat format, and preference alignment teaches it to pick the better of two answers.

site.label: 训练 · D0 流水线
训练 · Qwen3-0.6B 三步 SFT

nodes.title: 把图片切成词元：ViT
nodes.goal: 图片缩放后切成 16×16 像素的小块，每块变成一个向量，再像文字一样交给 Transformer。
nodes.goal_en: The image is resized and cut into 16×16-pixel patches; each patch becomes a vector and goes into a Transformer, just like text.

site.label: 多模态 · D3 逐层（切块、ViT 24 层）
site.label_en: Multimodal · D3 Layer by layer (patches, 24 ViT layers)

nodes.title: 图文对齐：多模态大模型
nodes.goal: 视觉编码器的输出经过 2×2 合并拼进对话，用 M-RoPE 标上时间、高、宽三个位置；生成每个字时，注意力会落回图上。
nodes.goal_en: The vision encoder's output is merged 2×2 and spliced into the conversation, with M-RoPE marking three positions — time, height, width. As each word is generated, attention falls back onto the image.

site.label: 多模态 · D2 流水线
多模态 · D3 逐层（M-RoPE、注意力热力图）
site.label_en: Multimodal · D3 Layer by layer (M-RoPE, attention heatmap)

nodes.title: 智能体：模型 + 工具 + 循环
nodes.goal: 让模型在循环里调用工具、读回结果、决定下一步；每一圈都把整段上下文重新喂进去，所以越滚越长。
nodes.goal_en: Let the model call tools in a loop, read back the results and decide the next step. Every turn feeds the whole context back in, so it keeps getting longer.

site.label: 智能体 · 修好失败的测试（D1 屏幕起）
site.label_en: Agents · Fix a failing test (from D1 Screen)

site.label: 智能体 · D2 循环 · D3 上下文

stages.title: 模型心里有没有一个世界

nodes.title: 逻辑透镜与线性探针
nodes.goal: 把中间层直接接到输出头上，读出模型“此刻会说什么”；再用线性探针从隐状态里读出城市的经纬度。
nodes.goal_en: Wire a middle layer straight to the output head to read what the model "would say right now"; then use a linear probe to read a city's latitude and longitude out of the hidden state.

site.label: 推理 · D3 层塔（逻辑透镜）
世界模型 · 城市探针

nodes.title: 世界模型：在梦里学
nodes.goal: VAE 把画面压成几个潜变量，RNN 预测下一步会变成什么样；有了它，智能体可以在模型“想象”出来的世界里练习。
nodes.title_en: World models: learning in a dream
nodes.goal_en: A VAE squeezes each frame into a few latent variables and an RNN predicts what comes next; with that, an agent can practise inside the world the model imagines.

site.label: 世界模型 · 在梦里玩
site.label_en: World Models · Play in the dream

nodes.title: 电路与特征
nodes.goal: 把模型拆成看得懂的部件：几个注意力头连成的“电路”，稀疏自编码器找出的“特征”，以及它们为什么会在那里。
nodes.goal_en: Break the model into parts you can understand: "circuits" made of a few attention heads, "features" found by sparse autoencoders, and why they are there.

site.label: 推理 · D5 算子（注意力汇聚）

nodes.title: 读一篇原始论文
nodes.goal: 学会一篇论文读三遍；从《Attention Is All You Need》开始，对照本站拆开的那一层逐段读。
nodes.goal_en: Learn to read a paper in three passes; start with "Attention Is All You Need" and read it section by section next to the layer this site takes apart.

site.label: 推理 · D4 一层之内（对照着读）
site.label_en: Inference · D4 Inside a layer (read alongside)

nodes.title: 跑起来，改一改
nodes.goal: 在自己电脑上跑通本页「动手试试」的片段，再用 nanoGPT 训一个自己的小模型：换一份语料、改一个超参数，看结果怎么变。
nodes.goal_en: Get this page's Hands-on snippets running on your own computer, then train your own small model with nanoGPT: swap in a different corpus, change one hyperparameter, and see what changes.

site.label: 本页 · 动手试试
